title: Donut-anti-freecam
description: An advanced anti-cheat plugin that detects and prevents freecam exploits.
body: **An advanced anti-cheat plugin that detects and prevents freecam exploits. Monitors player movement patterns, interaction distances, and packet anomalies to identify when players disconnect their camera from their body. Features configurable detection sensitivity, automatic violation handling, bypass permissions, and comprehensive logging. Includes alert system for staff members and customizable punishment actions**
